adjudication.rationale: Looking at the diff for GoogleCalendarService.ts, line 96 shows `const key = parseRefreshTokenResponse(googleCredentials, googleCredentialSchema);` which returns the result of `safeParse` (an object with `success` and `data` properties). Then line 97-99 shows `await prisma.credential.update({ where: { id: credential.id }, data: { key } })` - this persists the entire safeParse result object instead of `key.data`. Looking at parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts, it returns `refreshTokenResponse` which is the safeParse result containing `{success, data, error}`. The next time the credential is loaded, `googleCredentialSchema.parse(credential.key)` at line 78 would fail because it receives `{success: true, data: {...}}` instead of the actual credential data.
